title: hartmannia berlandieri
intro: Hartmannia berlandieri, commonly known as the Mexican hartmannia or Mexican silvermist, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hartmannia berlandieri are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
